Folder: /BP/TS-25 Feature area - Box scope - Own scope definition

6. Head To Jira -> Projects -> Backlog

7. Being in Backlog -> Change name of any Jira Issue
   Expected: Confirm the name Changed
8. Navigate to Gantt module of BoxName

   Expected: Verify that name of the task was updated

10. Being in Backlog -> Delete any issue -> head back to BigPicture -> Open the boxName -> Go to Gantt module

12. Being on Backlog -> Open any issue -> hit 3 dots -> hit Log Work -> Log any time spent
   Expected: Verify that under "More Fields" new field "Time Tracking" appears and the bar is filled
13. Navigate to Gantt module of BoxName -> Manage Columns -> Add new Column -> Time Tracking (Spent)
   Data: BoxName: TC-2746 Feature area - Box Scope - Scope Definition - Atlassian Cloud Webhooks - Issue, Issuelinks & Worklogs
   Expected: Verify that the number of time spent is correctly appearing
14. Bein on Gantt Module -> Create a link between tasks
   Data: Make sure to make all types of links:
1. has to be finished together with
2. has to be finished Before
3. has to be finished After 
4. has to be started together with
5. has to be started Before
6. has to be started After

15. Navigate to Projects -> Backlog -> Open the tasks on which links were created

16. Being in backlog on Jira -> Remove all the links created in previous steps
   Expected: head to BigPicture -> Gantt module Verify that all the links disappeared
17. Navigate to Jira -> Projects -> Backlog -> Create link between 2 tasks
   Data: Any of the folLowing will do: 
1. has to be finished together with
2. has to be finished Before
3. has to be finished After 
4. has to be started together with
5. has to be started Before
6. has to be started After
   Expected: Verify that the tasks were correctly linked
18. Go to Gantt module of Boxname -> Remove all links created from the previous step
   Data: BoxName: TC-2746 Feature area - Box Scope - Scope Definition - Atlassian Cloud Webhooks - Issue, Issuelinks & Worklogs
   Expected: Navigate to Projects -> Backlog -> Verify that all the links disappeared
